Container.Name: reality
Container.Overview: Prague property board. Checks Sreality, Flatzone developer price lists and novostavby.com on a schedule for apartments and houses, filters and ranks listings, and lets two people rate and comment with live updates.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the board is served on. Point the reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database: listings, change history, ratings, comments, run log.

Config.Name: Update schedule (cron)
Config.Description: Five-field cron in the time zone below. Default: 07:00 and 19:00.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA zone used for the schedule.

Config.Name: Users
Config.Description: Comma-separated names for the Rating as picker. Ignored when an SSO user header is set.

Config.Name: Max price (CZK)
Config.Description: Upper price limit for Sreality listings.

Config.Name: Min area (m2)
Config.Description: Minimum usable area.

Config.Name: Required features
Config.Description: Any of: parking, outdoor, cellar, ac, ev. A listing must have all of them.

Config.Name: Latest completion date
Config.Description: Under-construction listings finishing after this are dropped.

Config.Name: Move-in date
Config.Description: Shown on the page for context.

Config.Name: Houses enabled
Config.Description: Also search family houses around a centre point.

Config.Name: House search centre (lat,lon)
Config.Description: Centre of the house radius. Default: Náměstí Republiky.

Config.Name: House search centre name
Config.Description: Shown on the page next to distances.

Config.Name: House radius (km)
Config.Description: Straight-line distance from the centre.

Config.Name: House max price (CZK)
Config.Description: Defaults to the apartment limit.

Config.Name: House min area (m2)
Config.Description: Minimum usable area of the house.

Config.Name: House min plot (m2)
Config.Description: Minimum land. 1 = any land; houses with no plot stated are dropped.

Config.Name: House required features
Config.Description: Any of: garage, parking, ac, ev.

Config.Name: House Sreality regions
Config.Description: 10 = Praha, 11 = Středočeský kraj. The radius is applied on top.

Config.Name: House Sreality types
Config.Description: 37 rodinný, 39 vila, 40 na klíč, 54 vícegenerační; 33 chata and 43 chalupa are off by default.

Config.Name: House Flatzone areas
Config.Description: Where to look for developer houses before the radius is applied.

Config.Name: House distance score
Config.Description: Points at the centre, falling to 0 at the radius edge.

Config.Name: District scores
Config.Description: District:points pairs for ranking.

Config.Name: AC score
Config.Description: Points for air conditioning mentioned.

Config.Name: AC prep score
Config.Description: Points for prepared-for-AC.

Config.Name: EV charging score
Config.Description: Points for EV charging mentioned.

Config.Name: New build score
Config.Description: Points for new builds over resale.

Config.Name: Ownership
Config.Description: 1 = osobní vlastnictví only, 0 = any.

Config.Name: Sreality regions
Config.Description: Comma-separated region IDs. 10 = Praha, 11 = Středočeský kraj.

Config.Name: Sreality new-build conditions
Config.Description: 6 = novostavba, 4 = ve výstavbě, 5 = projekt.

Config.Name: Sreality resale conditions
Config.Description: 1 = velmi dobrý, 9 = po rekonstrukci, 2 = dobrý. Empty disables resale.

Config.Name: Flatzone enabled
Config.Description: Include unit-level developer price lists from flatzone.cz.

Config.Name: Flatzone project refresh (days)
Config.Description: How often to re-read project details (completion dates, parking, cellars).

Config.Name: Duplicate match distance (m)
Config.Description: Listings closer than this with the same layout, floor and size are merged.

Config.Name: Duplicate area tolerance (m2)
Config.Description: Allowed area difference between a developer listing and a portal listing of the same flat.

Config.Name: Novostavby.com enabled
Config.Description: Include developer projects from novostavby.com.

Config.Name: Novostavby locations
Config.Description: Term IDs: 2530 Praha, 1386 Praha-východ, 1519 Praha-západ.

Config.Name: Novostavby move-in years
Config.Description: label:termID pairs.

Config.Name: Re-check listings after (days)
Config.Description: Re-read unchanged listings this old to catch edited details.

Config.Name: Min minutes between manual checks
Config.Description: Rate limit for the Check now button.

Config.Name: Run on first start
Config.Description: Run a check at startup if none has succeeded yet.

Config.Name: SSO user header
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. X-authentik-username. Only set if the port is reachable solely through the proxy.
